scenes.narration: The problem isn't shipping too fast. It's shipping faster than anyone can explain what was built.

props.headline: Feature to Enablement Video Pipeline.
props.sub: At merge — the moment of maximum context — auto-draft a premium video and a one-pager.

scenes.narration: So we built the bridge. When a feature merges, at the moment of maximum context, it auto-drafts a premium enablement video and a one-pager.
It reads the context of what changed, writes the story, skins it in UiPath brand, narrates it, and drafts the video — automatically.

items.title: Knows what shipped

items.title: Knows where it fits
items.desc: the customer problem it actually solves

items.title: Knows how to position it
items.desc: the talk track, and when to bring it up

items.title: Knows the right-fit customer
items.desc: who to pitch it to — and who not to

scenes.narration: So sales instantly knows what shipped, where it fits, how to position it, and which customer it's the right fit for.
And it never ships on its own. A merge triggers capture, not publish — every video is a draft a person signs off before it reaches a customer.
From merged to sellable — automatically, and on brand.
